component.name: Divider
component.description: A horizontal line that separates groups of content inside one container.

useWhen: Separating distinct sections within a Card or page layout
Creating visual breaks between list items or content groups

notFor.case: A top or bottom border on a container
notFor.because: Card and Box already carry border tokens; a Divider duplicates the boundary.
notFor.note: Use the container's own border. Divider separates content inside a container.

patterns.name: section-break
patterns.useWhen: Separating groups of fields or content inside one card.
